# SoftTricksCode — Full Documentation & Company Overview

> SoftTricksCode is a premier software engineering company delivering full-stack web applications, custom website development, mobile apps (iOS & Android), AI & machine learning solutions, cloud deployment, and scalable digital systems.

## Company Overview

- **Company Name**: SoftTricksCode
- **Website**: https://softtrickscode.com
- **Founders**: Md Saif Ali (Founder & Lead Engineer), Ashwini T Gadad (Co-Founder & Product Strategist)
- **Headquarters / Operations**: India (Operating globally for clients worldwide)
- **Primary Contact**: softtrickscode@gmail.com
- **Core Specializations**: Custom Web Development, Full-Stack SaaS Platforms, Mobile App Development (React Native / Flutter), AI Agent & ML Solutions, Cloud & DevOps (AWS / GCP), UI/UX Design & Brand Identity.

## Services Offered

### 1. Web Development
We create modern, accessible, and high-performance websites engineered for speed, SEO, and user conversion.
- Technologies: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.
- Key Capabilities: Custom responsive design, Lighthouse 100/100 performance, semantic accessibility, headless CMS integration.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

### 2. Full-Stack Web Applications & SaaS
End-to-end software architecture for complex digital platforms and cloud-native applications.
- Technologies: Node.js, Express, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL, REST APIs.
- Key Capabilities: Multi-tenant architectures, secure authentication (OAuth/JWT), payment gateways (Stripe/Razorpay), real-time dashboards (WebSockets).
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

### 3. Mobile App Development
Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android with native feel and buttery 60fps animations.
- Technologies: React Native, Expo, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin.
- Key Capabilities: Offline-first data synchronization, push notifications, camera/hardware APIs, app store deployment.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

### 4. AI & Machine Learning Solutions
Intelligent systems that automate complex business workflows and deliver predictive insights.
- Technologies: OpenAI API, Gemini API, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, Vector Databases (Pinecone/ChromaDB).
- Key Capabilities: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), custom chatbots, automated document processing, computer vision.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

### 5. Cloud Architecture & DevOps
Scalable, zero-downtime infrastructure design and continuous deployment pipelines.
- Technologies: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify.
- Key Capabilities: Serverless architectures, container orchestration, automated CI/CD, database clustering.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

### 6. UI/UX Design & Branding
Clean, human-centered interfaces and distinctive corporate identity systems.
- Technologies: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Design Systems, Motion Graphics.
- Key Capabilities: Interactive prototypes, wireframing, WCAG AA accessibility compliance, design token architecture.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/services

## Portfolio & Projects

- **Computer World**: Modern computer sales & repair platform featuring real-time inventory and customer enquiries.
- **E-commerce Website for Men**: Scalable online storefront with cart management, payments, and product filtering.
- **Agriculture Management System**: IoT and weather-integrated farm monitoring dashboard.
- **Healthcare & Hospital Portal**: Patient appointment scheduling, doctor directory, and medical history system.
- **EdTech Learning Management**: Interactive course management platform with live quizzes and video streaming.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/portfolio

## Pricing & Engagement Models

SoftTricksCode offers transparent and negotiable pricing tiers tailored to project scope:
- **Starter Package**: Ideal for landing pages, portfolio sites, and local businesses.
- **Professional Package**: Ideal for growing startups needing custom web apps or e-commerce platforms.
- **Enterprise Package**: Dedicated engineering squad, custom SaaS platforms, and enterprise SLAs.
- Link: https://softtrickscode.com/pricing
